source.text: በውእቱ፡ መካን፡ ርኢኩ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ዘኢይትኄለቍ፡ ወ*አውዳ፡ የአውዳ፡ ብዙኃ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ጽሙኣን፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ይሰትዩ፡ ወይትመልኡ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወመኃድሪሆሙ፡ ምስለ፡ *ጻድቃን፡ ወቅዱሳን፡ ወኅሩያን።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: In that place I saw a spring of righteousness that is never exhausted. Many springs of wisdom surrounded it. All the thirsty drink from them and are filled with wisdom, and their dwelling is with the righteous, the holy and the chosen.

source.text: ወበይእቲ፡ ሰዓት፡ ተጸውዐ፡ *ወልደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዝኩ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወስሙ፡ መቅድመ፡ ርእሰ፡ መዋዕል።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: At that hour that Son of Man was named before the Lord of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected second clause is abbreviated: and his name before the Head of Days. The naming verb is understood from the preceding clause, not supplied as a new personal name. The titles Son of Man, Lord of Spirits and Head of Days are retained without inserting a later identification.

source.text: ወዘእንበለ፡ ትትፈጠር፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወታእምር፡ እንበለ፡ ይትገበሩ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወስሙ፡ ተጸውዐ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: Before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of heaven were made, his name was named before the Lord of Spirits.[a]

footnotes.text: Signs follows the sign or celestial-sign sense, not an added list of constellations. The verse says that his name was named before the Lord of Spirits; it does not print an additional personal name here.

source.text: ውእቱ፡ ይከውን፡ በትረ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ከመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይትመረጐዙ፡ ወኢይደቁ፡ ወውእቱ፡ *ብርሃነ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ተስፋ፡ ለእለ፡ የሐምሙ፡ በልቦሙ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: He will be a staff for the righteous, so that they may lean on it and not fall. He is the light of the nations, and he will be hope for those whose hearts are in pain.

source.text: ይወድቁ፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ የኃድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወይሴብሕዎ፡ ወይባርክዎ፡ ወይዜምሩ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: All who dwell on dry land will fall down and bow before him. They will praise him and bless him, and sing to the Lord of Spirits.[a]

footnotes.text: The first two praise verbs have him as their object; the singing clause explicitly names the Lord of Spirits. That sequence is retained rather than making every clause name the same recipient or assigning an unprinted identity.

source.text: በእንተዝ፡ ኮነ፡ ኅሩየ፡ ወኅቡአ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ *ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: For this reason he was chosen and hidden before him, before the world was created, and forever.

source.text: ወ*ከሠተ፡ *ለቅዱሳን፡ ወለጻድቃን፡ ጥበቡ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ እስመ፡ ዐቀበ፡ ክፍሎሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ እስመ፡ ጸልእዎ፡ ወመነንዎ፡ ለዝ፡ ዓለም፡ ዘዓመፃ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ምግባሮ፡ ወፍናዊሁ፡ ጸልኡ፡ *በስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ እስመ፡ በስሙ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ይድኅኑ፡ ወበፈቃዱ፡ ኮነ፡ ሕይወቶሙ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: He revealed the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits to the holy and the righteous,[a] because he preserved the portion of the righteous. They hated and rejected this world of unrighteousness, and hated all its deeds and its paths in the name of the Lord of Spirits, because in his name they will be saved, and by his will their life came to be.

footnotes.text: The selected revealing construction is compressed and its subject/object relation remains unresolved. This provisional rendering takes an implicit he as revealer and the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits as the object. Another construal makes wisdom the agent and understands a reference to the figure of48:6. Neither a new object nor an added passive prefix is inserted into the selected source. The unit remains held pending grammatical adjudication; the rest of its clauses have been included rather than clipped.

source.text: በ†ክንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ክኑ፡ ትሑታነ፡ ገጽ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ምድር፡ ወጽኑዓን፡ እለ፡ ይእኅዝዋ፡ ለየብስ፡ በእንተ፡ ምግባረ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ በዕለተ፡ ጻዕቆሙ፡ ወጻሕቦሙ፡ ኢይድኅኑ፡ ርእሶሙ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

additional_translation_input.english_scope: Opening in those days only; no other actor, tense or clause replaced.
additional_translation_input.textual_reason: Selected opening is expressly corrupt. Reported Ethiopic form supplies the readable opening without silently treating the editor suggestedዝንቱ as main text.

translation.text: In those days[a] the kings of the earth and the mighty who hold the dry land were downcast in face because of the work of their hands, for they will not save themselves in the day of their pressure and distress.

footnotes.text: The selected opening actually prints the daggered በ†ክንቱ, not a sound phrase in those days. Charles printed91 note15 calls it corrupt and reports በውእቱ for m, t and β. This English adopts that reported Ethiopic opening, in those days; the source preserves the damaged selected form unchanged. Charles also proposes that ክንቱ is corrupt for ዝንቱ, but this English does not pretend that conjecture is the selected main reading or a freshly collated manuscript. The rest of the verse retains the downward state and the negative future salvation clause.

source.text: ወውስተ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ ለኅሩያን፡ ዚአየ፡ እወድዮሙ፡ ከመ፡ ሣዕር፡ ውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ከመዝ፡ ይውዕዩ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ከመ፡ ዐረር፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ ይሠጠሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኢይትረከብ፡ ሎሙ፡ አሰር።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: I will put them into the hands of my chosen ones.[a] Like grass in the fire, they will burn before the holy ones. Like lead in water, they will sink before the righteous, and no trace of them will be found.[b]

footnotes.text: The selected verse shifts to my chosen ones and I will put. It does not introduce a newly named speaker at this point, and none is inserted into the English.

The metal word can cover lead or tin in the primary lexicon; lead is used here in the sinking comparison. The fire verb belongs to the heat or burning range, not an unprinted detailed mechanism of annihilation. The negative no-trace clause is retained.

source.text: ወበ*ዕለተ፡ ጻሕበ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ ዕረፍት፡ ትከውን፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወበቅድሜሆሙ፡ ይወድቁ፡ ወኢይትነሥኡ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትሜጠዎሙ፡ በእዴሁ፡ ወያነሥኦሙ፡ እስመ፡ ክሕድዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወለመሢሑ፡ ወይትባረክ፡ ስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: On the day of their distress there will be rest upon the earth. Before them they will fall and will not rise. There is no one who will take hold of them with his hand and raise them, because they denied the Lord of Spirits and his Anointed One.[a] May the name of the Lord of Spirits be blessed.

footnotes.text: Anointed One renders the title with its his suffix; the source does not replace it with an additional personal name here. The hand expression uses the take-up or support verb, supported by Dillmann1865 column225 with an explicit48:10 citation. His hand is retained, not changed to the fallen people’s own hands. The whole unit continues from printed91 onto92.

source.text: እስመ፡ ጥበብ፡ ክዕወ፡ ከመ፡ ማይ፡ ወስብሐት፡ ኢትኃልቅ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

additional_translation_input.english_scope: Passive has been poured out only; selected wisdom, water comparison, glory/negative and duration retained.
additional_translation_input.textual_reason: Readable passive adopts the explicitly reported Ethiopic passive variant rather than silently assigning passive value to the selected shortened form or adding an unexpressed active actor.

translation.text: For wisdom has been poured out like water,[a] and glory does not cease before him forever and ever.

footnotes.text: The selected pouring form is shortened and grammatically difficult. For this English passive, wisdom has been poured out, I adopt the Ethiopic passive variant ተክዕወ reported for m, t and β in Charles printed92 note11. The selected source form ክዕወ is preserved unchanged, not silently treated as an assured passive or supplied with a new active agent. This is an explicit edition-reported variant choice, not a fresh manuscript collation.

source.text: እስመ፡ ኃያል፡ ውእቱ፡ በኵሉ፡ ኅቡአተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወዓመፃ፡ ከመ፡ ጽላሎት፡ የኃልፍ፡ ወምቅዋመ፡ አልቦ፡ እስመ፡ ኅሩይ፡ ቆመ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወስብሐቲሁ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ ወኃይሉ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: For he is mighty in all the hidden things of righteousness. Unrighteousness passes like a shadow, and there is no opponent.[a] The Chosen One has stood before the Lord of Spirits, and his glory is forever and ever, and his power from generation to generation.

footnotes.text: The selected negative expression has the opponent or resisting form; the primary lexicon gives an adversary or one who contradicts. No object of resistance is explicitly named here, so the English does not add against him or change it into a new action.

source.text: ወቦቱ፡ የኃድር፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ዘያሌቡ፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ትምህርት፡ ወኃይል፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ እለ፡ ኖሙ፡ በጽድቅ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: In him dwells the spirit of wisdom, the spirit of understanding, the spirit of instruction and power, and the spirit of those who slept in righteousness.[a]

footnotes.text: The understanding expression is a relative verbal construction in the selected text; the primary root covers making someone understand or intelligent. Spirit of understanding renders that sense without identifying an extra agent. The final clause literally refers to those who slept in righteousness; it is not silently replaced with a new title for their spirits.

source.text: ወውእቱ፡ ይኴንን፡ ዘኅቡአተ፡ ወነገረ፡ በከ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ ብሂለ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ እስመ፡ ኅሩይ፡ ውእቱ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ በከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ፈቀደ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text full-page/native collation; selected stars and dagger retained, raised apparatus references excluded and punctuation spacing normalized. Any reported Ethiopic variant adopted only in English is substantive additional_translation_input below. No later English oracle or fresh manuscript certification.

translation.text: He judges what is hidden, and no one can utter a vain word before him,[a] because he is the Chosen One before the Lord of Spirits, as he himself willed.

footnotes.text: The selected expression is a word of emptiness or vanity. It is rendered vain word rather than narrowed without explanation to a specific lie or accusation. The final he himself is retained without naming an additional subject.
